_about: Curated travel-medicine rules for MedPassport. Statuses: prohibited, permit_required, prescription_required, caution, allowed. lead_days = how many days before departure paperwork should be started. This is a hackathon dataset compiled from official sources and government travel advice; rules change, so the app always shows the source and asks the traveller and doctor to confirm with the embassy or regulator.

general.details: Carry a copy of the prescription and keep medicines in original packaging. Bringing more than a one-month supply of prescription medicine requires an import confirmation (Yunyu Kakunin-sho) arranged before travel.

decongestant_precursor.details: Japan treats some foreign cold medicines containing pseudoephedrine as stimulant raw material. Do not pack them; a home prescription does not protect you.

stimulant_amphetamine.details: Amphetamine-based ADHD medicines (e.g. Adderall, dexamphetamine) are prohibited in Japan even with a prescription.

stimulant_methylphenidate.details: Methylphenidate is strictly controlled. Confirm quantity limits and permission requirements with Japan's Narcotics Control Department before travel.

opioid.details: Codeine and other narcotic medicines need prior permission from Japan's Regional Bureau of Health and Welfare. Apply at least 14 days before the trip.

benzodiazepine.details: Psychotropic medicines are allowed only in personal-use quantities with a prescription. Larger amounts need approval.

z_drug.details: Psychotropic sleeping tablets are allowed only in personal-use quantities with a prescription.

cannabinoid.details: Products containing THC are illegal in Japan, including medical cannabis prescribed abroad.

general.details: Carry the prescription and keep medicines in original packaging. Controlled medicines need prior approval from the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention, usually for up to 30 days of treatment.

opioid.details: Codeine and Tramadol are controlled in the UAE. Get prior approval from the Ministry of Health and Prevention, and carry the prescription and a medical report.

gabapentinoid.details: Pregabalin (Lyrica) and Gabapentin are controlled in the UAE. Get prior approval and carry the prescription.

benzodiazepine.details: Sleep and anxiety medicines such as benzodiazepines are controlled in the UAE. Get prior approval and carry the prescription.

z_drug.details: Sleeping tablets are controlled in the UAE. Get prior approval and carry the prescription.

stimulant_methylphenidate.details: ADHD medicines such as Ritalin are controlled in the UAE. Get prior approval and carry the prescription.

stimulant_amphetamine.details: Amphetamine-based ADHD medicines are controlled in the UAE. Get prior approval before travel.

decongestant_precursor.details: Cold medicines containing pseudoephedrine are controlled in the UAE; carry a prescription.

cannabinoid.details: All cannabis products are illegal in the UAE, even with a prescription from your home country.

antiviral_sensitive.details: Travellers have been detained or deported for carrying HIV or hepatitis medication. Check current entry rules with the embassy before travelling.
